messages:
Carmen Support: ACME reports sudden 429s on their dedicated pool after changing quota in console yesterday, ticket ACME-1234. they said UI reflected the new numbers but traffic dropped after deploy.

Samir Oncall: which pool and the exact payload they submitted? can you paste audit log?

Carmen Support: pool dp-eu-3, tenant acme-prod. UI showed "600 per minute". audit entry shows raw payload: ```{\"tenant_id\":\"acme-prod\",\"rate_units\":600,\"rate_unit\":\"seconds\"}``` so it looks like UI vs API disagree on the unit. :grimacing:

Anjali Infra: that would make the effective limit 600/sec not 600/minute. sounds like a unit-parsing bug in the UI->API mapping. can ops repro quickly?

Mike Reliability: repro plan for SRE: 1) use an ACME API key 2) run short cURL loop to ~10 qps 3) observe X-RateLimit headers and limiter logs. post results here.

Samir Oncall: running local loop against dp-eu-3 with sandbox key: ```for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code} %{time_total}\\n\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ACME_KEY\" https://inference.redwood/api/v1/generate; sleep 0.09; done``` after ~40 reqs started seeing 429s. response headers: X-RateLimit-Limit: 600, X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0, Retry-After: 2

ACME ProdOps: confirmed from our side. we clicked "per minute" in UI and entered 600. no app changes.

Carmen Support: filing as P0. UI shows minute but audit payload says seconds. likely mapping regression from recent quota-ui PR.

Anjali Infra: note: autoscaler didn't react because limiter rejected requests before queue depth hit autoscale threshold. also noisy neighbor on same pool raised CPU and consumed token budget which amplified the outage. root cause still unit mismatch.

Mike Reliability: timeline: 14:03 quota edit -> 14:05 429 symptoms -> 14:10 ops routed traffic away -> 14:12 applied tenant override -> 14:15 errors dropped. temporary override fixed it. adding to ticket notes.

Samir Oncall: ops workaround used: ```# temporary override redwoodctl quota override set --tenant acme-prod --rate-units 36000 --unit seconds # move to quiet pool redwoodctl tenancy move --tenant acme-prod --pool quiet-eu-1``` advised customer to hold off on console edits until fix.

ACME ProdOps: override cleared it fast, thanks. can you confirm other tenants won't be impacted by the same UI bug?

Anjali Infra: checking scope now. I see a recent change in the quota UI component that changed how the unit enum is serialized (PR #3582). backend expects canonical seconds but UI may send minute literal. will prepare hotfix to send canonical value and add unit conversion tests.

Mike Reliability: impact estimate: 4 tenants had UI edits on dp-eu-3 in last 24h. only ACME produced production traffic hitting hard limits. preemptively applied soft overrides to the others.

Samir Oncall: logs: "rate-limiter: tenant=acme-prod limit=600 unit=seconds consumed=600 remaining=0" and tracer: "limiter.Evaluate() returned THROTTLED at 2026-03-16T14:05:12Z"

Deploy-Bot: deploy queued: quota-ui-mapping-fix -> staging at 2026-03-16T14:50:02Z :rocket:

Carmen Support: next steps for teams: - frontend: hotfix mapping + unit tests (Anjali) - infra: backfill detection script to find mismatches between UI selection and audit payload (Mike) - support: customer comms + credits for affected window.

Anjali Infra: ETA: patch merged to staging, running e2e. backfill will run during low traffic window 02:00 UTC with strict safety checks (only change rows where UI selection != stored unit).

Mike Reliability: rollout plan: prod feature-flag roll for 1h with close monitoring: 429 rate, pool queue length, and X-RateLimit diffs between UI and audit. add an alert when an edit produces >2x discrepancy.

ACME ProdOps: please add ACME-1234 to migration whitelist for manual validation.

Carmen Support: done. increased ticket to P0 and added postmortem follow-ups.

Samir Oncall: quick postmortem summary: root cause = UI->API unit enum mismatch (minute vs seconds) causing tenants to be throttled far below intended rate; noisy neighbor and autoscale behavior worsened the customer experience. mitigations: hotfix, backfill, overrides, and runbook updates. :white_check_mark:

Mike Reliability: I'll draft the formal postmortem and update the runbook. follow-ups assigned: INF-7242 (frontend hotfix), INF-7243 (backfill script), INF-7244 (runbook updates).
